title: Haptics

summary.en: A short vibration on phones that support it, always together with a visible change, never alone. Four kinds: light for a tap that changed something, medium for a gesture that committed, success when something finished, error when something was refused.
summary.id: Getaran singkat di ponsel yang mendukungnya, selalu bersama perubahan yang terlihat, tidak pernah sendirian. Ada empat jenis: light untuk ketukan yang mengubah sesuatu, medium untuk gestur yang dijalankan, success saat sesuatu selesai, error saat sesuatu ditolak.

en.title: The four kinds
en.desc: On an Android phone with vibration, press each one. On desktops and on iPhone browsers nothing happens, which is why haptics only add to what the screen already shows.
en.html: Light 8 ms, medium 14 ms, success 10 + 40 + 18 ms, error five pulses of 12 and 30 ms.

en.title: Built in where it belongs
en.desc: The like buzzes light when it fills; the confirm buzzes light when it asks and success when it is done; a refused shake buzzes error.
en.html: Clear history? Clearing check_circleHistory cleared

id.title: Empat jenis
id.desc: Di ponsel Android yang bisa bergetar, tekan satu per satu. Di desktop dan browser iPhone tidak terjadi apa-apa, karena itu haptics hanya menambah apa yang sudah tampil di layar.
id.html: Light 8 ms, medium 14 ms, success 10 + 40 + 18 ms, error lima denyut 12 dan 30 ms.

id.title: Sudah terpasang di tempatnya
id.desc: Like bergetar light saat terisi; konfirmasi bergetar light saat bertanya dan success saat selesai; shake karena penolakan bergetar error.
